records.source: A crudely fashioned point used for hunting.
records.translation: Magaspang ang pagkakayaring tulis na ginagamit sa pangangaso.

records.preserveReason: Artichoke is the standard borrowed Filipino name for this specific vegetable.

records.source: The bud of a thistle plant. The spiny outer leaves conceal a fleshy, filling interior.
records.translation: Usbong ng halamang matinik. Itinatago ng matitinik na panlabas na dahon ang malaman at nakakabusog na loob.

records.englishResidueReason: Artichoke is the standard borrowed Filipino name for this specific vegetable.
Artichoke is the standard borrowed Filipino name for this specific vegetable.

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 8 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang mahinog.

records.source: How did you get this in your inventory?
records.translation: Paano mo ito nailagay sa iyong imbentaryo?

records.source: A blacksmith can open this for you. These troves often contain ancient relics and curiosities.
records.translation: Maaaring buksan ito ng isang panday para sa iyo. Madalas maglaman ang mga sisidlang ito ng mga sinaunang relikya at pambihirang bagay.

records.source: Causes fish to bite faster. Must first be attached to a fishing rod.
records.translation: Pinabibilis ang pagkagat ng isda. Kailangang ikabit muna sa pamingwit.

records.source: Baked fish on a bed of herbs.
records.translation: Isdang inihurno sa sapin ng mga halamang pampalasa.
Matamis at mayaman sa gawgaw na tropikal na prutas.

records.source: A creamy dessert with a wonderful tropical flavor.
records.translation: Malapot na panghimagas na may napakasarap na tropikal na lasa.

records.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Banana tree. Bears fruit in the summer, or all year round when planted on Ginger Island.
records.translation: Tumatagal ng 28 araw upang maging ganap na puno ng Saging. Namumunga sa tag-init, o buong taon kapag itinanim sa Isla ng Luya.

records.source: Makes your catch more secure, causing the "fishing bar" to cling to your catch. Works best on slow, weak fish.
records.translation: Mas pinatitibay ang pagkakahuli dahil kumakapit sa huli ang "bar ng pangingisda". Pinakamahusay sa mababagal at mahihinang isda.

records.source: The best specimens resemble a desert rose.
records.translation: Ang pinakamagagandang halimbawa ay kahawig ng rosas ng disyerto.
Nabubuo malapit sa napakainit na magma.

records.source: Improves soil quality a little, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Bahagyang pinahuhusay ang kalidad ng lupa at pinatataas ang tsansang magpatubo ng de-kalidad na pananim. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.source: This soil has a chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: May tsansang manatiling nadiligan ang lupang ito magdamag. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.

records.source: It's fully charged with precious energy.
records.translation: Ganap itong puno ng mahalagang enerhiya.

records.englishResidueReason: Bean is retained as the recognizable generic crop-item noun because the dish does not identify a specific Filipino bean variety.
